title: Squarespace to Google Sites - How to Connect Your Domain to Google Sites Step by Step
description:
Here, you will learn how to connect a domain you bought on Squarespace to a site published on Google Sites — step-by-step and updated for 2026. This walkthrough shows the exact sequence: publish your Google Site, verify domain ownership in Google Search Console, add the required DNS records in your Squarespace domain settings, and finish the publish/redirect so visitors land on your Google Sites URL with HTTPS working. The end result: your custom domain (for example www yourdomain com ) serves your Google Site reliably and securely. 

I cover the two key DNS actions you’ll use: (1) verifying ownership (usually via a TXT record) and (2) creating the CNAME entry for www → ghs.googlehosted.com so Google can serve your site. I explain when you should use a root redirect (so example.com forwards to www example com) rather than trying to point the apex with CNAME, and why many people prefer the www + redirect approach for Google Sites. 

You’ll also get practical Squarespace steps: where to find DNS/Advanced settings, how to add or replace a CNAME record, and how to create a 301 redirect from the root if you don’t add apex records — plus tips for avoiding common errors (invalid CNAME entries, multiple conflicting records). I explain what to expect during DNS propagation, how long SSL might take to issue, and quick troubleshooting checks if the site doesn’t appear after changes. 
At the end I show how to verify HTTPS is active, test on mobile, and confirm Search Console/site publish status so search engines index your new address. The video is paced so you can follow along in real time and pause at each DNS change.

title: How to Delete Domain on Hostinger 2026 Easily
description:
Here is How to Delete Domain on Hostinger 2026 Easily.

In today's video, I'm going to teach you how to delete a domain on Hostinger. If you're new to managing your domains or looking to clean up your web hosting account by removing an unused domain, you're in the right place. This step-by-step guide will walk you through the process of deleting a domain from Hostinger seamlessly. Let's get started!

First things first, you'll need to navigate to the Hostinger website. Simply open your preferred browser and enter the URL. Hostinger serves as your gateway to taking your ideas online, offering a robust platform to efficiently manage your domains and websites. Once you're on the Hostinger homepage, your next step is to log into your account. At the top of the homepage, you'll see the login button. Click on it, and a prompt will appear asking for your credentials. Enter your email and password, and hit that login button to access your account.

Accessing HPanel, Hostinger's control panel, is crucial for managing your domains, so keep your login details handy. Once logged in, you'll be directed to the Hostinger homepage. This is your control hub, where you can navigate to any part of your hosting service. To proceed, look for the HPanel link, which will direct you to your central management area, specifically tailored by Hostinger to make website management easy.

Great! Now that you're in HPanel, you'll want to look for the 'Websites' section. You can usually find this option within your dashboard menu. It's where all your website-related services are organized, making management straightforward and intuitive. Now that you're in the 'Websites' section, scan for the specific domain you wish to delete. This section is designed to show you all the websites and respective domains linked to your account. Once you locate the correct domain, proceed by clicking on it to see more management options.

With your chosen domain in view, direct your attention to the available actions. Among them should be the delete button. Click on 'Delete,' and you'll likely be prompted to confirm your decision. It might seem a bit daunting, but this confirmation ensures that you truly intend to proceed with this action and helps avoid accidental deletions.

And there you have it! You've successfully deleted a domain from your Hostinger account. It's always wise to double-check that the unwanted domain is indeed removed from your list to avoid any potential confusion later on. This process may seem brief, but taking these steps accurately is crucial for maintaining a clean and efficient hosting experience. Whether cleaning up old projects or making space for new ones, Hostinger makes domain management accessible and straightforward.

Thank you for watching, and I hope this guide was helpful. Be sure to subscribe for more insightful tips and guides on managing your online presence!

title: How to Change Font Size in TradingView 2026 Easily
description:
Here I will show you How to Change Font Size in TradingView 2026 Easily.

In this video, I'll guide you through the process of how to change font size in TradingView, allowing you to customize your charts to better fit your preferences or needs. Whether you're preparing for a professional presentation or simply personalizing your workspace, these changes can make a significant impact.

First, ensure you're logged into TradingView and head to the chart section. On your chart, locate the gear icon in the upper right corner—this settings button opens the door to a variety of customization options. Click it to access the settings menu.

Within the settings menu, navigate to the ""Canvas"" tab. This is where you can modify the chart's aesthetics. Among the options available, focus on text formatting. Here, you can change the font size to enhance the readability of annotations or notes. Use the slider or input box to adjust the size, ensuring it aligns with your chart layout and the information displayed.

Additionally, you can modify text line spacing to avoid cramped text or to add more distinction between lines, making annotations clearer. Don't overlook the option to change font color. Selecting a color that contrasts with your chart background can improve visibility, making your notes or labels stand out more effectively.

Once you're satisfied with your adjustments, click the ""OK"" button to save and apply these changes to your TradingView chart. By customizing the font settings, you enhance your analytical work, making charts clearer and more aligned with your style. Remember, clear visuals are crucial when analyzing data or sharing insights. Thanks for watching, and happy charting!"
